findings.title: Costs
findings.text: Slippage and commissions cost 0.039R per trade on average (+0.050R before costs, +0.011R after). Costs are affordable here.

findings.title: Win rate vs what's needed
findings.text: Win rate 46.4% against about 45.8% needed to break even with the actual average winner (+1.00R) and loser (-0.85R). Median target was 1.5R; only 6.0% of trades ever reached +2R before exiting.

findings.title: False breakouts
findings.text: 39.9% of stopped trades were stopped within 2 bars of entry: the move reversed almost immediately. Not unusually high.

findings.title: Giving back winners
findings.text: 5.2% of losing trades were up at least +1R at some point before turning into a loss. Few losers were ever meaningfully profitable, so exit management isn't the main problem.

findings.title: Stop placement
findings.text: 2.5% of stopped trades went on to reach the original target later the same day; 50.0% of those never went more than 1.5R against the entry first, so a somewhat wider stop might have held. Wider stops mean smaller positions, so this is a trade-off to test, not a fix.

findings.title: Long vs short
findings.text: Best: short +0.186R over 211 trades (95% interval [-0.048, 0.433]). Worst: long -0.158R over 220 trades (interval [-0.341, 0.027]).

findings.title: Trading with or against the trend
findings.text: Best: no clear trend +0.110R over 37 trades (95% interval [-0.203, 0.369]). Worst: against trend -0.067R over 171 trades (interval [-0.264, 0.135]).

findings.title: Time of day
findings.text: Best: 09:30-10:00 open +0.102R over 157 trades (95% interval [-0.148, 0.349]). Worst: 11:30-14:00 midday -0.094R over 56 trades (interval [-0.477, 0.348]).

findings.title: Choppy markets
findings.text: Best: trending / expanding +0.018R over 398 trades (95% interval [-0.107, 0.16]). Worst: choppy / consolidating -0.078R over 33 trades (interval [-0.263, 0.144]).

findings.title: Late / extended entries
findings.text: Best: extended (>1.5 ATR from 9 EMA) +0.130R over 134 trades (95% interval [-0.116, 0.368]). Worst: near 9 EMA (<=1.5 ATR) -0.043R over 297 trades (interval [-0.155, 0.073]).

findings.title: Volume confirmation
findings.text: Best: volume confirmed +0.193R over 105 trades (95% interval [-0.099, 0.505]). Worst: weak volume -0.048R over 326 trades (interval [-0.15, 0.069]).

findings.title: Volatility
findings.text: Best: high-vol +0.092R over 157 trades (95% interval [-0.11, 0.284]). Worst: normal-vol -0.036R over 274 trades (interval [-0.171, 0.138]).

findings.title: Checklist score
findings.text: Best: checklist 50-69 +0.135R over 136 trades (95% interval [-0.036, 0.303]). Worst: checklist < 50 -0.060R over 198 trades (interval [-0.211, 0.084]).

findings.title: Setups with positive evidence
findings.text: None. No setup or ticker slice has an out-of-sample 95% interval entirely above zero.

diagnostics.caveat: These slices describe past out-of-sample trades. Choosing filters from them and re-testing on the same trades would be curve-fitting; any idea here must be confirmed on later data.

search.note: Each fold tried 12 parameter combinations on its training window and kept the best. The more combinations tried, the more the training winner is a lucky draw - which is exactly why only the following, unseen test window is reported.
